tasks.label: Build SmartNetworkFailover
tasks.command: if not exist build mkdir build && call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\BuildTools\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -arch=x64 && cl /EHsc /I include /Fo:build\ src\main.cpp src\NetworkMonitor.cpp src\SocketManager.cpp src\WiFiManager.cpp src\Checksum.cpp src\Logger.cpp /Fe:build\SmartNetworkFailover.exe
